name: Send Email via Gmail
description: Compose and send an email through Gmail. Handles MIME encoding, base64url conversion, HTML formatting, CC/BCC, and reply threading automatically.

isHtml.description: Set true if body is already HTML. Otherwise plain text is auto-converted.

threadId.description: Thread ID to attach this email to (for replies)

inReplyTo.description: Message-ID of the email being replied to

references.description: Space-separated chain of Message-IDs for threading

labelIds.description: Label IDs to apply. Defaults to ['INBOX', 'UNREAD'].

steps.name: Build MIME message and base64url-encode it
Send the encoded email via Gmail API
